posts.title: The problem with definitions
posts.description: I was at LeadDev Berlin earlier this month, and a lot of the conversations kept circling back to metrics. The thing I kept coming back to, though, is that pretty much all of these metrics work just fine in theory. The problem is that every one of them depends on a handful of definitions, and these definitions are where things start getting a bit tricky.

posts.title: Trust, Collaboration, and Basketball
posts.description: It's pretty well known that for teams to work well, there needs to be trust. The thing is, it's said so often that I think it's lost its meaning a bit. Everybody says they trust folks, but then their behavior doesn't actually show that.
